svg.title: enrutador
svg.text: v2 · open source · Claude Code mod
I measured it on 275 turns of my history.
It compacts the session when the context passes 200k and runs subagents on Sonnet. v1
only switched models and saved 0%: the measuring tool ships in the repo.

g.text: turn ends at 420k → compacts · re-reads 30k per step
Explore subagent → Sonnet · its own context
